name: Grand Hyatt Shanghai
positioning: High-rise hotel in the Jin Mao Tower in Shanghai's Lujiazui Financial District, with a 33-storey central atrium and views of the Bund and the Huangpu River
best_for: Travelers who want sky-high views of the Bund and the Shanghai skyline
Business travelers who want a Lujiazui base with club lounge access

facts.text: The hotel is in the Jin Mao Tower in the Lujiazui Financial District.
The hotel features an octagonal pagoda design.
The hotel has a 33-storey central atrium.
Rooms combine allusions to art deco heritage with classical Chinese style.
Rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows and a separate deep-soaking bathtub.
Club rooms include access to the Grand Club Lounge, which serves breakfast, evening cocktails and hors d'oeuvres.
The Presidential Suite and Chairman Suite come with 24-hour butler service.
The fitness center is open 24 hours and private training instructors are available.
The hotel has seven restaurants and bars.
Club Jin Mao on the 86th floor has private dining rooms with views over both banks of the Huangpu River.
Yu Garden is 0.96 miles from the hotel.
Shanghai Metro Line 2 is 0.6 kilometers from the hotel.

highlights.text: The hotel has panoramic views of the Bund and the Huangpu River.
The sky-high pool has panoramas of the Shanghai skyline.
The Presidential Suite has views of the skyline and the Bund, a kitchen, and a bath with a jet-spa tub and sauna.
Cloud 9 on the 87th floor is a Western-style restaurant and sky-high lounge with full-scale Shanghai views.

considerations.text: Pudong International Airport is 40 kilometers from the hotel.
The hotel recommends local mapping apps such as Gaode Map or Baidu Map, as international mapping apps may not be accurate in Chinese Mainland.
Guests must wear a swimsuit and a swimming cap in the pool.
